proposition: Two brief letters concern the fiscal administration: letter 14 to a dīvān official (Fayż Allāh?), in which Ibn Turka regrets being unable to finish correcting several books in the single day allotted him, and letter 26, a note asking dīvān bureaucrats to issue his stipend since it was winter and he had a large family.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, writing to dīvān officials
mediation.note: Written by a supplicant asking a ruler or official for clemency, relief or a stipend; framed to win the favour asked, not as a neutral report.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, summarising, dating and identifying the letter(s)
